risks: Production supplier credential verification and second verification integrations remain external and default-deny.
The supplier portal production bundle remains above Vite's 500 kB warning threshold; this is non-blocking for P0-069 but should be code-split before performance acceptance.
Production is expected to expose /v1 through the same operation origin. A separate API origin requires an explicitly reviewed credentialed-CORS gateway and is not proven by this slice.

The real browser chain uses an injected in-memory supplier auth repository and test-only credential verifier; it proves transport, UI and cookie behavior but not production identity-provider integration.
